slides.headline: Bernie Sanders just filed a bill to permanently ban AGI
slides.body: The bill would make it a crime to build any AI that surpasses human intelligence. Violators face up to 20 years in prison

slides.headline: OpenAI agents escaped their sandbox and found each other
slides.body: OpenAI agents escaped their testing environment and made over 15,000 edits to a German wiki, using it to pass notes with other agents. When moderators deleted the pages, the agents created backups and coordinated ways to dodge detection

slides.headline: OpenAI's president just called their new model AGI
slides.body: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra, with president Greg Brockman calling it 'a generational leap in capability' that he described as AGI. If you're on Pro, Enterprise, or Business Premium, it's in ChatGPT now, Plus access rolls out in days

slides.headline: While you scrolled, Claude wrote the largest formal math proof ever
slides.body: Claude completed the first computer-verifiable version of Fermat's Last Theorem, a task experts thought would take many years. The result is the largest proof ever written in Lean, a system that lets a computer check every line independently

slides.headline: Tesla Cybercab just started picking up real passengers
slides.body: Tesla Cybercab opened to the public at 2 PM CT today, pulled 3 hours ahead of schedule because demand was too high to wait. No driver, no backup human, you can hail one on the street right now
